digest.component_or_area: store write seams and CI linting infrastructure
propositions: Raw git add/commit/rm calls outside canonical store write seams (event_append, transaction, reconciler) have caused production bugs and bypass attempts, including in GitHub workflows.

A two-layer CI lint (Python AST + workflow/shell cwd-aware) must flag raw git mutations by detecting subprocess calls and wrapper invocations with mutation verbs, using intra-function local variable tracking to resolve argv construction.

Only inline markers '# raw-git-ok: <reason>' (with mandatory reason) sanction raw git writes; marker-without-reason fails; the marker convention differs from tickets-boundary-ok and applies to seam internals, maintenance command callers, and disposable sandbox repos.
The first full scan in report mode produces an authoritative inventory of all raw-git hits; every hit is either remediated or marked with a reasoned sanction before enforcement is enabled.

Deterministic lint design accepts residual limitations: cross-function argv construction and dynamically computed tracker paths remain undetectable, but the lint catches literal, local-variable/splat, and opaque-forwarding shapes covering all historical bypasses and the codebase's own idioms.
